dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed sequence of four prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped motifs along the mid-lateral flank. These structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from dark-valued outer perimeters to light-valued interior cores with irregular, non-circular boundary geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters localized on the ventral-lateral interface and neck folds, characterized by solid intensity with minimal internal spatial variance.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three macro-annuli on the mid-body form a scalene triangle, with the longest edge running parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis.
